records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $194.3 million for the three months ended June 30, 2025 compared to $199.9 million in the three months ended June 30, 2024, a decrease of $5.6 million, or 2.8%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $309.4 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 compared to $295.6 million in the six months ended June 30, 2024, an increase of $13.8 million, or 4.7%.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in sales for the six months ended June 30, 2025 compared to the same period in 2024 is a result of improved snowfall in our core markets leading to higher Attachments volumes in the first quarter of 2025, as well as price increase realization and strong municipal volumes at Solutions.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in sales for the three months ended June 30, 2025 compared to the same period in 2024 is a result of lower volumes related to the timing of preseason shipments in our Attachments business between the second and third quarters, somewhat offset by price increase realization and strong municipal volumes at Solutions.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities decreased $6.4 million from the six months ended June 30, 2024 to the six months ended June 30, 2025.
